transitionAndTestPartition.when: NEW receives the exact valid incoming application ./view edge with target cache absent
transitionAndTestPartition.effects: Only the one actual saved View-load window opens.

transitionAndTestPartition.when: ENTERING completes original View native load, all three initial requests exactlyonce/order, loadedtrue/cache/exports identity and no active frame
transitionAndTestPartition.effects: Permanently close the initialization window; no later adoption/reinitialization.

transitionAndTestPartition.when: SEALED receives load or resolve FROM the unchanged genuine captured View, with all identity/cache/exports/loaded/descriptor invariants intact
transitionAndTestPartition.effects: Deny capability with TEMPLATE_ENGINE_DISABLED via existing persistent latch exactlyonce and zero saved-forward/lookup/provider/storage/DB effects. This deliberate denial throw must occur outside any initialization-poisoning catch/finally. Expected denial is consumed; unexpected denial increments persistent unexpected and still fails live acceptance without resetting it.

transitionAndTestPartition.when: Any identity/cache/prototype/filename/id/exports/loaded descriptor invariant fails, or an initialization window/order/count/frame is invalid
transitionAndTestPartition.effects: Latch permanently before rejection. In a live fixture abort the run; restoring external data or another call can never regain readiness.

transitionAndTestPartition.when: The exact incoming initialization forward or an admitted View initial-request forward throws or fails its completion checks
transitionAndTestPartition.effects: Latch permanently, close windows/frames in finally and rethrow the original exception unchanged; no retry/adoption. A nested unrelated optional error caught normally by the library does not count unless it propagates out of the admitted forward.

transitionAndTestPartition.when: An ordinary unrelated request is forwarded through existing loader policy
transitionAndTestPartition.effects: Return/throw the original result/error unchanged. Do not catch every ordinary load as a guard failure. In particular an existing exact optional MODULE_NOT_FOUND/catch cannot poison NEW or SEALED.

transitionAndTestPartition.when: FAILED receives any later guard load/resolve/assertSealed/open attempt
transitionAndTestPartition.effects: Deny without savedforward and without any reset/replacement/reinitialization; live runtime cannot continue nominal.
